Wide data: character matrix column names one row per variable one column per wave (psychonetrics design); row names become labels. id, wave Long data : names person wave columns. Neither may contain missing values one vars, person one row per wave. Waves ordered factor level order, value numbers, dates times, numerically character values numbers, alphabetically (warning) character values; pass factor set order. select Edge selection: "none" (default) estimates every edge reports significance; "prune" removes non-significant edges refits (see Details); "ebic" estimates penalized networks penalty chosen EBIC. alpha Significance level, (0, 1), significant flag, solid dashed edges plot(), pruning. Default 0.01, psychonetrics::prune(). adjust Multiplicity correction p-values tested pruning, one stats::p.adjust.methods. Default "none". Used select = "prune"; reported p-values significant flags always unadjusted. recursive select = "prune": repeat pruning edge p > alpha. Default FALSE. stepup select = "prune": pruning, add back removed edges improve fit (see Details). Default TRUE, one-pass pruning can remove parameters non-significant jointly significant, autoregression correlated cross-lagged effects. FALSE gives pruning alone. criterion stepup: "bic" (default) also requires BIC decrease edge added; "none" uses significance tests . gamma, nlambda, lambda_min_ratio select = "ebic": EBIC hyperparameter (default 0.5), number penalty values (default 50, whole number >= 2), smallest penalty fraction largest (default 1e-4). refit select = "ebic": refit selected networks unpenalized maximum likelihood, standard errors p-values available.
